title: Thigh-High Slit Knit Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegant and flattering, this midi dress frames the neckline beautifully with its soft V-neck and flutter sleeves. The draped waist helps shape the figure, while the ruffle front and asymmetrical hem add movement and show a little more leg. A lovely choice for weddings, cocktail parties, evening events, and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
